items.title: Public comment at Library Trustee Development Committee
items.summary: Residents can speak for up to 3 minutes at this hybrid meeting of the Library Trustees' development committee, which will discuss a November board presentation on intellectual freedom and new trustee onboarding.

items.title: New Trustee onboarding
items.summary: Committee discussion of how new library trustees are onboarded.
items.skip_reason: Internal board administration, not open to public input.
